findings.area: pifiyyot part scopes vs existing XML
findings.detail: The part boundaries match the existing heyeh_im_pifiyot.xml. /3 ends at יְבָרְכוּן and /4 starts at וּמִבִּרְכוֹת. /8 ends at שְׁאוֹנָם and /9 starts at וְאַל יֹאמַר. /12 is וְנֶאֱמַר plus Ps 69:7. /13 is the seven-line Ochilah core. /14 is Prov 16:1, /15 Ps 51:17 and /16 Ps 19:15. The English splits at the same places, so /3→/4 and /7→/8 continue mid-sentence in lowercase, as printed. Small wording differences (כְּמוֹ/כְּמָה, אֶת/אֵת, מְסַבְּבִים/מַסְבִּיבִים, חֵימָה/חֵמָה) are text variants within the same part. The exception is /11. The existing /11 contains the whole of Exod 33:19 (וַיֹּאמֶר … לְפָנֶיךָ וְחַנֹּתִי … אֲרַחֵם). s258 prints only 'כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וְחַנֹּתִי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אָחֹן. וְרִחַמְתִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אֲרַחֵם:'. Using corresp /11 is still the right identity, but the unit must record that this witness leaves out 33:19a. identity_evidence should not claim the scopes match exactly.

The atnah of Exod 33:19 falls on לְפָנֶיךָ, so the printed וְחַנֹּתִי…אֲרַחֵם is exactly half-verse b, and the s259 English quotes only that half. Unlike every other quotation in the file, the /11 quotation has no contextual chapter_corresp or source_reference_corresp. Its URN 'urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:exodus/33/19/b' is not shown to exist in the Bible URN scheme or registry.

he /12 (s258) is page_start true, but s258 begins with וְחֵימָה, the second fragment of /6; /12 is the small centred block after the regional rubric, mid-page. he Ochilah /13 (s258) is page_start true, but it is mid-page after the Ark-opening note. The same rule applied in weekday makes the first fragment false when the page started earlier. en /6 second fragment (s259) is page_start false, but s259 begins 'Holy Ark in awe…', so it must be true. This is the same bug fixed in weekday and Shabbat, where page_start was used to mean paragraph start.

On s258, /6–/11 run on as one paragraph and /12 is set apart in smaller centred type, so he paragraph 2 is right. The English /12 is a separate small-type paragraph with the cue ונאמר, and Ochilah has the cue אוחילה; both cues are correctly left out of the English text. 'בפפד״מ, מעץ ורוב קהלות אין אומרים.', 'פותחים הארון.' and 'סוגרים הארון.' are correctly kept in service_instructions and not in the word targets.

reuse.ochilah_traditional_core is still goldman/6, but the units file correctly uses heyeh_im_pifiyot/13–16, and the existing /13–16 cover the printed Ochilah exactly. identity_scope_evidence still says 'Reuse /12 with local rite condition', which breaks the rule that no condition goes inside word targets; the units file correctly sends it to the service spine. The status still says decisions are pending.
